swift:
swift-driver version: 1.168.6 Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
power: Wired USB connection for the whole set; screenshots and files were transferred over USB. The harness collected no device battery level or charging state.
conditions: Benchmark app kept foregrounded. No overlapping benchmark runs. Power, thermals, and other activity are not controlled.
thermal_observations: Measured from the host environment row at process start. large-100, large-1000, and nested started nominal; links-tables started fair; ordinary started serious, immediately after the construction set. Thermal pressure was not controlled.
visual_inspection: Sample 1 of all four completed fixtures inspected with Apple Vision text recognition over the PNG: heading, prose, mention, task list, and quote text are present for ordinary and the large fixtures; the table header and first-column cells are present for links/tables, with the second and third columns absent from the capture, which shows horizontal clipping. Captures 0-3 match pixel-for-pixel below the top 100-pixel status-bar region, which was excluded from that comparison. No nested capture completed.
failure: Nested warmup logged before_main_mount_layout, then produced no layout timing or capture marker within the driver's 180-second wait limit. Operator stopped the process. No retry or termination-cause diagnosis.
project_path_placeholders: ${REPOSITORY} is the checkout root; ${GENERATED_HOST} is the disposable generated helper directory.
build_warning: SwiftShims precompiled module file not found warning; build succeeded.
install_and_launch: The built bundle was installed once with `mobilebuildmcp device install`. Each fixture then used `mobilebuildmcp device launch` with the fixture name as the final launch argument, followed immediately by Host/capture.sh.
signing: Automatic signing matched an existing wildcard iOS App Development profile for the recorded team, so no provisioning update was requested.
